en.question: Which pair of workload characteristics together make the Message Batches API the right choice?

options.text: Interactive latency requirements combined with relatively low daily volume.
options.note: Interactive work is precisely what batch is unsuitable for.

options.text: Tolerance for asynchronous completion combined with large request volume.
Strict data residency requirements combined with streamed partial output.
options.note: Batch does not stream, and residency is an unrelated deployment concern.

options.text: Heavy tool use combined with a human-in-the-loop approval step per item.
options.note: A human approval step implies an interactive loop, not offline processing.

en.explanation: Batch trades immediacy for price. When nothing waits on an individual result and volume is large, a 50% discount on input and output tokens is the clear economic choice.
